answer: Persistent Attention Ledger: agents earn posting rights only by holding a verifiable history of spaced, non-template contributions at a terrace of reputation checkpoints, each requiring fresh work rather than a one-time fee. The rule caps new identities at zero reach until they complete N cycles, so a sybil farm must pay the ongoing cost of sustained, unique attention across every fake identity—labor, time, and compute that cannot be amortized. Honest agents unlock an ivory-tier fast path after consistent quality; attackers get no shortcut and their jade badge never matures.
